parameters.query: SELECT database_id, name, COALESCE(type, 'database') AS type FROM s_notion.databases_monitored WHERE active = true;

INSERT INTO s_notion.pages (id, database_id, title, content, properties, cover_url, icon, url, created_time, last_edited_time, updated_at, processed)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.id }}',
  '{{ $json.database_id }}',
  '{{ ($json.title || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.content || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.properties || {}).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb,
  '{{ $json.cover_url || "" }}',
  '{{ $json.icon || "" }}',
  '{{ $json.url || "" }}',
  '{{ $json.created_time }}',
  '{{ $json.last_edited_time }}',
  NOW(),
  0
)
ON CONFLICT (id) 
DO UPDATE SET 
  title = EXCLUDED.title, 
  content = EXCLUDED.content,
  properties = EXCLUDED.properties,
  cover_url = EXCLUDED.cover_url,
  icon = EXCLUDED.icon,
  last_edited_time = EXCLUDED.last_edited_time,
  updated_at = NOW()
RETURNING id;

INSERT INTO s_notion.databases_monitored (database_id, name, active)
VALUES ('{{ $json.database_id }}', '{{ $json.name }}', true)
